correctness.rationale: For odd k every odd prime maps to an even composite; composite maps to prime. Thus cycles avoiding 2 alternate and have even period, giving unique possible odd orbit. Any five-cycle must contain 2, and its five successive states are forced: 2, k+2, 2k+2, q=P+(k+1), k+q. Exact return requires k+2 prime, q>2, and k+q a power of 2. Conversely the same tests yield a return after five distinct states. Python3 verifies the arithmetic iff against direct map iteration for all 100001 odd shifts through k=200001; the proof handles all odd shifts independently of this finite regression.
